name: opencode-ccode-auth
description: OpenCode/magpie provider plugin for CCode (ccode.si): points at its API endpoint and reads plan balance

summary.en: CCode (ccode.si) provider: sign in with an API key, chat on its models, and see plan balance and usage in magpie.
summary.zh: CCode（ccode.si）供应商：填 API key 即用全部模型，并在 magpie 里显示套餐余额与用量。
